highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 while improving GTK4 GPU rendering and platform support.
highlights_body: The release restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling, and aligns native assets with .NET 11 previews.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to the Skia m156 engine and incorporates the current m155 fork cleanup.
Linux packages without bundled dependencies can again discover system fonts through the installed font configuration.

bullets.lead: GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling
bullets.detail: GTK4 hosts can use native GPU rendering with scaling that matches the display pixel density.
Updates .NET 11 preview package pins and the WebAssembly native assets for the current SDK preview line.
Builds and packages native assets with the GCC 14.2 toolchain required for Tizen 10.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages
